enrolment.title: Start the worker on the node
enrolment.explain: Put these three values in the .env of the node, then start the worker. The token works once and expires at {{time}}.
enrolment.once: This token is shown only now. If you lose it, enrol again.
localExplain: This is the node Armadok runs on. The hub acts on it directly, so there is no worker to install.
enrolTip: Creates a short-lived token that links a worker on that machine to this hub.
pingTip: Sends a harmless message to the worker and waits for the answer
revokeTip: Cuts the link: the worker can no longer receive orders.
revokeConfirm: Revoke this worker? The node will be unreachable until you link a worker again.
